_readme: High/critical production advisories accepted for now.
Checked by scripts/audit-production-cves.mjs. Every entry needs a reason,
and the reason should say what would have to change for it to be removed.
`workspace` is the lockfile's directory ('.' for the repository root).
Unused entries are reported, not fatal, so they can be deleted.

allow.reason: node-forge RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature VERIFICATION accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements. Unfixable today: the advisory covers <=1.4.0 and 1.4.0 is the latest release; @parse/node-apn pins exactly 1.4.0, and firebase-admin only drops it in a major upgrade (12 -> 14). Not reachable: push-relay's own code never imports node-forge, and both dependents use it only to PARSE keys and certificates (pem.decode/encode, privateKeyFromPem, decryptRsaPrivateKey, certificateFromAsn1, getPublicKeyFingerprint) — never to verify a signature, which is where the flaw is. Remove when node-forge publishes a fixed release (then `npm audit fix` in services/push-relay), or when @parse/node-apn and firebase-admin no longer depend on it. Re-check reachability if either dependent is upgraded. Accepted 2026-10-02.
